ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white fields dominate the lateral lobes. A central vertical low-intensity black band extends from the peduncle attachment to the median notch. Low-intensity black pigmentation is also concentrated along the entire trailing edge and in sparse mottling across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits deeper, more jagged valleys and peaks (possible trauma-induced) compared to the more uniform small-scale serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve on both lobes extending from the center toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (mottling) scattered across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple dark linear rake marks: three distinct parallel diagonal lines on the right lobe and one prominent diagonal line on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged edges on the right lobe trailing edge. Presence of a foreign object (yellow synthetic rope/line) wrapped around the distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of bright yellow entanglement material on the left tip is a highly unique visual marker.
